text:
Maya: quickcheck — pushed ESM rewrite of node quickstart. updated README code samples from require() -> import. Local test passes for node 18, but CI (ubuntu-latest) shows bundler error in sample-build.
Jordan: can you paste the failing error? CI logs?
Maya: `Error: Cannot use import statement outside a module` when running `node sample/dist/index.js` after `npm run build`
Sam: that usually means package.json missing \"type\": \"module\" or build producing commonjs. what's package.json look like?
Maya: it's minimal. snippet:
```
{
  \"name\": \"redwood-sample\",
  \"version\": \"0.1.0\",
  \"main\": \"dist/index.js\",
  \"scripts\": { \"build\": \"tsc && rollup -c\" }
}
```
Rae: try adding `\"type\": \"module\"` to package.json, or change Rollup output.format to 'cjs'. For quickstart we prefer ESM. Also need `exports` field for node resolution.
Chris: volunteer to open a tiny PR to add type/module and update CI matrix to test node 16 & 18. i'll add a note about vite/webpack consumers.
Jordan: +1 please include a short note in the README about ESM vs CJS and how to run with `node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node` if needed for older tests.
Maya: thanks. blocker lifted for me once we add type. i'll wait for the PR then re-run tests.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-485.docs.redwood.ai — includes updated README and sample diff :eyes:
Sam: sweet. after PR merges can someone update quickstarts index page to mention node compatibility? i'd also like a small CI job that runs `node dist/index.js` to catch this earlier.
Chris: will add the CI job in the PR.
Maya: today: follow up on PR feedback, add a one-liner about ESM/CJS in quickstart. yesterday: converted sample to ESM, fixed a streaming bug when using SDK streaming api.
Rae: FYI I fixed a doc typo in the streaming example earlier — no rollout needed. :sparkles:
Jordan: thanks team. no more blockers from docs side.
